transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I came in because my mind just will not hold onto things anymore. I'll sit down to write a simple note for the youth maker program—something I could have done in my sleep before—and... the numbers and words just scatter on me. I can't seem to pull my thoughts together at all.
Aside from these issues with your thinking, have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or depressed lately?

Yes, I have. Most days, I wake up with this heavy... hollow feeling right in my chest. And even when my wife is talking kindly to me, trying to reach me, I just feel like I'm sitting at the bottom of a well. It's just very persistent.
Have you ever experienced a period of feeling down or depressed like this at any earlier point in your life?
No, I haven't. I mean, I've had normal bad days over the years, like anyone else, but... nothing like this. I've never had this kind of heavy, persistent feeling before. This is all new to me.
Have you recently been diagnosed with any new medical conditions, or had any major changes in your physical health?
No, I haven't. My physical health is... well, it's pretty much the same as it's always been. I haven't been diagnosed with anything new, or had any major physical changes like that.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in doing things that you normally enjoy?

Yes, I have. I just... I haven't touched the wood pieces sitting on my workbench in weeks. I've also been skipping choir planning, and my chess games. Even fishing... normally I'd be out there, but lately it just sounds like more effort than it's worth. It's really not like me at all to just drop everything like this.
Did your memory and thinking difficulties begin around the same time that your mood started to drop?

I haven't really noticed any problems with my memory or my thinking, to be honest. I mean, my mind feels clear enough. It's really just the mood and... well, not wanting to do anything. So no, I wouldn't say I've had any memory issues.
How long have you been experiencing this low mood and loss of interest?
It's been about three weeks now. It all started right after my older sister died.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep patterns, such as trouble falling asleep, waking up during the night, or sleeping too much?

No, I haven't really noticed any changes there. My sleep has been about the same as always. I usually go to bed and sleep through the night just fine. I don't have any trouble falling asleep, and I'm not sleeping during the day or anything like that. So, no, no issues with my sleep.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or lacking in energy lately?

No, I can't say that I have. My energy levels seem pretty normal, really. I mean, I know I mentioned earlier that I don't want to do anything, but that's not because I'm physically exhausted or tired. I just... don't have the drive for it right now. But physically, my energy is fine.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or your weight over these past few weeks?

Yeah, I have. Food has mostly lost its appeal lately. I kind of just... push my breakfast around the plate in the mornings. And by the time supper rolls around, my wife is usually reminding me that I've barely eaten anything all day. I just don't really have the desire to eat right now.
Have you been struggling with feelings of worthlessness or feeling excessively guilty about things lately?

No, I haven't really felt that way. I don't have any reason to feel guilty about anything, and... well, I don't feel worthless, either. Like I was saying before, I just don't have the interest or drive to do much right now, but it's not because I'm sitting around beating myself up or feeling bad about who I am. So, no, I wouldn't say I've had any issues with guilt or feeling worthless.
Have you had any thoughts of harming yourself, or felt like life isn't worth living?

Yes, I have. Honestly, I keep thinking that my family might just be better off without me around. It's... well, when I'm out near my workshop, I actually get scared of where my thoughts could go if I were left alone out there. So, yes, those kinds of thoughts have definitely been on my mind.
